Definition: properly, an appointment, i.e. a fixed time or season; specifically, a festival; conventionally a year; by implication, an assembly (as convened for a definite purpose); technically the congregation; by extension, the place of meeting; also a signal (as appointed beforehand)
BiblicalUsage: 1) appointed place, appointed time, meeting; 1a) appointed time; 1a1) appointed time (general); 1a2) sacred season, set feast, appointed season; 1b) appointed meeting; 1c) appointed place; 1d) appointed sign or signal; 1e) tent of meeting
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
